aliases: Clean Cloud Energy Mohave data center
status_detail: Clean Cloud Energy/Entrata concept reported as a potential 776-acre AI data center site near White Hills Airport with up to $12.5B investment, 34 modules, three high-voltage substation pads, hybrid cooling/water plant, and power/water intended to be supplied onsite or through project-controlled resources; county zoning still requires case-by-case special use approval for data centers.
notes: County official page confirms 2025 public hearing on Ordinance 2025-05 requiring data centers to provide on-site energy and dry cooling; project details come from AZBEX/public-record reporting and meeting transcript summaries, not a final county approval.

aliases: Pegasus Group Holdings renewable energy data center
developer: Pegasus Group Holdings / Plus Minus Power
status_detail: Originally announced in 2019 as a 717-acre, $3B solar-powered modular data center south of Kingman; later reporting says the project never started construction and was officially cancelled in mid-2021.
notes: Included as a cancelled/rejected historical project because the brief asks to count rejected projects and avoid omissions.

Found marketing of the Winslow Mega Site/I-40 TradePort as suitable for data-center demand and social-media claims about a Winslow/Joseph City proposal, but no verifiable official county application, approval, permit, named developer commitment, or project record suitable for a project row.

aliases: Bobcat Tucson Water LLC data center
status_detail: Pima County describes Project Blue as a proposed 290-acre data center campus west of Houghton Road and north of the Pima County Fairgrounds, with $3.6B total capital investment, first phase supporting four buildings and up to ten buildings total; later news reports construction underway and ADWR well approvals tied to the project.
notes: County page is primary source for site, scale, economic-impact and timeline details; developer identity inferred from Pima/press reporting on Beale-linked Bobcat entities.

project_name: Luckett Road North and South Data Centers
status_detail: Town of Marana received two rezoning applications for Luckett Road North and South parcels being considered for potential data center development; Planning Commission recommended rezoning on December 10, 2025 and Town Council heard/approved the project on January 6, 2026 according to town/local reporting.
notes: Town source verifies applications and hearings; acreage/developer details supplemented by local reporting. Marana spans Pima/Pinal, but project is treated here under Pima because local reporting links it to the Southern Arizona/Pima County data center cluster.

aliases: La Osa Data Center and Power Complex
status_detail: Vermaland's La Osa Energy Center is a proposed Pinal County energy/data-center complex south of Eloy. After public opposition, plans were reduced from 59 data-center buildings to an 11-building campus on roughly 3,300 acres; Board of Supervisors public hearing was continued to August 26, 2026.
notes: Official Pinal agenda/result pages were checked; project-specific details are best captured in local/business-news summaries and P&Z coverage.

developer: Fairview Capital LLC / Selma & Midway LLC
status_detail: Pinal County agenda item PZ-PA-013-25 describes a 215-acre comprehensive-plan amendment for a data center campus at the southwest corner of Selma Highway and Midway Road, north of I-8; later action summary says rezoning to I-3 was requested to facilitate the data center campus.
notes: County agenda/action summary are primary evidence; developer/owner names from action-summary excerpt.

aliases: W Holdings Energy Generation and Technology Campus
status_detail: Pinal County resolution 2025-PZ-PA-015-25 approved a major comprehensive plan amendment for an Energy Generation and Technology Campus generally northeast of Maricopa Road and Teel Road in unincorporated Pinal County; news describes the proposal as a data center, battery energy storage facility, and natural gas power plant campus south of Maricopa/Ak-Chin.
notes: County resolution confirms land-use approval; local news provides data-center component and $10B construction/equipment estimate.

status_detail: MDC Data Centers lists NOG1 at 81 N Sonoita Ave, Nogales, AZ as a carrier-neutral data center and cross-border connectivity gateway; third-party data-center directories list the facility as operational/active.
notes: Capacity varies by directory: DataCenterMap shows 0.2 MW while OCOLO lists 1.0 MW; used 1.0 MW and noted uncertainty.

status_detail: City of Hayward lists STACK SVY03A as under construction; CEC docket 23-SPPE-01 says STACK Infrastructure proposes a campus at 26203 Production Avenue with backup generators up to 76.6 MW and project status Exempted.

status_detail: Valley Oak Partners proposed a 490,000-square-foot, 90 MW data center at 37887 Shinn Street in Fremont in 2023; City of Fremont's data-center page says there are currently no proposed data centers and that the applicant is no longer seeking a data center at the site.
notes: Fremont official page was visible in search excerpt but returned 403 on open; included because the official snippet directly states no pending applications/no longer seeking data center.
